import datetime,http.client,json,ssl
host="hexalith-keys.openbao.svc.cluster.local"
out={"source_pod":"redis-stack-0","source_container":"redis","credentials":"none; clean environment; no Authorization or token headers", "response_bodies":"not read", "requests":[]}
for verify in [True,False]:
    for path in (["/v1/sys/health?standbyok=true"] if verify else ["/v1/sys/health?standbyok=true","/v1/sys/mounts","/v1/auth/token/lookup-self"]):
        c=ssl.create_default_context() if verify else ssl._create_unverified_context()
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection(host,8200,context=c,timeout=6)
        item={"path":path,"certificate_verification":verify,"started_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
        try:
            conn.request("GET",path,headers={"Connection":"close"})
            response=conn.getresponse()
            item["http_status"]=response.status
            response.close()
        except Exception as e:
            item["failure_type"]=type(e).__name__
        finally:
            conn.close()
            item["finished_utc"]=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            out["requests"].append(item)
out["limits"]="Unverified TLS requests prove source-pod transport/HTTP and credential-free denial only; no CA identity, negative NetworkPolicy, authenticated ACL, cross-prefix or audit-write proof"
print(json.dumps(out))
